dedupe_keys.name: san francisco green roofs layer datasf

description: This layer holds the green roofs shown on San Francisco's Green Roofs web map, the Planning Department's inventory of known vegetated roofs in the city. The City and County of San Francisco publishes it on DataSF, and it is harvested into data.gov, where the dataset was last updated in April 2024. The Planning Department's green roofs page carries the map and further information, and a named planner adds new roofs that the public reports. Coverage is San Francisco. Format and access: JSON, XML, CSV, KML and GeoJSON downloads through the DataSF API. Licence: not stated on the data.gov entry; free. Caveats: it is a voluntary inventory that grows as roofs are reported, so it is incomplete, and the fields were not listed on the page read. It supports stormwater and heat studies of green roofs as green infrastructure. Related catalogue records are Chicago's green roofs survey and San Francisco's street tree inventory.
